core: Protein lysine acetylation and histone lysine methylation
name: Lysine acetylation and KMT2/WDR5 histone methylation complexes
rationale: Members concern lysine acetylation (histones, tubulin, centriole regulators) and histone lysine methylation; the WDR5/MLL4 (KMT2D) methyltransferase complexes distinguish it from BAF/CHD remodeling and general protein-methylation neighbours.

name: Extracellular matrix proteolysis and hyaluronan turnover
rationale: Members cover MMP activation, collagen and elastin degradation and endopeptidase regulation of matrix disassembly; hyaluronan synthesis/degradation and ectodomain shedding separate it from fibrinolysis/coagulation and collagen-assembly neighbours.

name: Mycobacterial subversion of phagosome acidification and lysosomal fusion
rationale: All members describe phagosome/endosome acidification and phagolysosome fusion or Mtb blockade of these host defenses, whereas neighbours emphasize Mtb metabolism, apoptosis, iron or other pathogens' entry.

name: RB-E2F G1/S and G2/M cell cycle checkpoint control
rationale: Members span RB/E2F/DREAM control of G1/S, CDK inhibition and G2/M checkpoint and mitotic entry events; lacking APC/C mitotic-exit and E2F G1/S-transcription-only content of the neighbours.

name: Common-pathway coagulation, factor V and fibrinolysis
rationale: Members cover coagulation initiation, common pathway and fibrin formation (including factor V cleavage defects) plus fibrin clot dissolution, unlike neighbours centred on contact/intrinsic factors XII, VIII, IX or VWF.

name: Retinal lamination and DSCAM/sidekick/nectin neuronal adhesion
rationale: Members combine retinal layer formation and retinal neuron differentiation with DSCAM, SDK and nectin adhesion and dendrite self-avoidance, distinguishing it from L1-family axonal adhesion and photoreceptor-only neighbours.

name: Stress granule assembly and arsenite/PKR stress response
rationale: Members concern stress granule assembly, localization and disassembly triggered by arsenite and PKR signaling (with PML bodies), unlike neighbours about proteasomal degradation, mRNA stability or heat shock.

core: Peroxisomal very-long-chain and ether lipid metabolism
name: Mevalonate-cholesterol synthesis and peroxisomal very-long-chain lipid metabolism
rationale: Members combine cholesterol/isoprenoid biosynthesis with VLCFA synthesis/catabolism, plasmalogen and alpha-oxidation peroxisomal lipid metabolism; the sterol branch separates it from beta-oxidation and peroxisome-import neighbours.

qualifier: feedback inactivation and atypical ERK5/ERK3/4 cascades
name: MAPK feedback inactivation and atypical ERK5/ERK3/4 cascades
rationale: Members cover ERK inactivation and negative feedback plus atypical MAPK cascades (ERK5, MAPK6/4), distinguishing it from neighbours defined by phosphatase dephosphorylation and JNK/p38 regulation.

name: Monocyte inflammatory TLR signaling by endogenous ligands
rationale: Members are monocyte/myeloid inflammatory and TLR signaling modules including endogenous-ligand and heme TLR activation, unlike neighbours focused on LPS/TLR2 detection, MHC II or neutrophil degranulation.

name: Glutathione degradation, gamma-glutamyl cycle and cystine transport
rationale: Members cover glutathione catabolism via GGT1, OPLAH and ACY1 and glutathione/cystine transport, distinct from neighbours about glutathione synthesis or cystinuria transporters.

name: Cholesterol homeostasis via HDL clearance and efflux restraint
rationale: Members regulate sterol homeostasis through reverse cholesterol transport, HDL clearance and suppression of efflux and synthesis, unlike neighbours centred on SREBP/LXR, LDL receptors or efflux promotion.

name: Lipoxygenase-derived resolvin, protectin and maresin biosynthesis
rationale: Members are lipoxygenase products of PUFAs, chiefly omega-3 resolvins, protectins and maresins, whereas neighbours concern lipoxins, hepoxilins and leukotriene catabolism.

name: Microglial activation, proliferation, migration and cytotoxicity
rationale: All four members are microglial effector behaviours, distinct from neighbours about amyloid clearance, synaptic maintenance or macrophage CSF1 signaling.

name: Bile acid homeostasis and biliary-intestinal sterol transport
rationale: Members cover bile acid synthesis, recycling, signaling and secretion plus ABCG5/8, ABCB4/11 biliary transport and intestinal lipid absorption, separating it from alternative bile-acid synthesis and lipoprotein-remodeling neighbours.

qualifier: piRNA transposon silencing and sperm chromatin
name: Germline piRNA transposon silencing and sperm chromatin remodeling
rationale: Members concern piRNA biogenesis and transposon heterochromatin silencing with germline events like sperm DNA condensation and protamine replacement, unlike neighbours on germ-cell specification, imprinting or spermatogenesis genes.

name: Wnt/Hedgehog ligand lipidation, secretion and Wnt/Ca2+ signaling
rationale: Members cover Wnt and Hedgehog ligand palmitoylation, autoprocessing and release plus non-canonical Wnt/Ca2+ signaling, distinguishing it from palmitoylation-only, Hh receptor/GLI and canonical Wnt neighbours.

name: IL-12-driven Th1 differentiation and IFN-gamma antigen presentation
rationale: Members cover IL-12/JAK-STAT Th1 differentiation, IFN-gamma response, MHC I/II regulation and DC activation, unlike neighbours on IFNG signal regulation, Treg/Th17 or DC cytokine production.

core: Plasma membrane amino acid and peptide transport
name: Oligopeptide and imino/neutral amino acid transport
rationale: Members cover proton-coupled oligopeptide transport and neutral/imino amino acid transporters (Hartnup, iminoglycinuria), distinguishing it from cystine/urate SLC neighbours and cationic/branched amino acid transport.

core: NMDA receptor signaling and synaptic plasticity
name: NMDA receptor signaling and structural synaptic plasticity
rationale: Members cover NMDA/AMPA receptor signaling, LTP/LTD and spine and structural plasticity, unlike neighbours centred on CREB transcription or kainate/AMPA receptor activation.

name: Retinoid metabolism: retinol oxidation to retinoic acid
rationale: Members cover retinol, retinal and retinoic acid metabolism, unlike neighbours about the visual retinoid cycle or CYP26 RA degradation defects.

name: Regulation of atrial and ventricular cardiomyocyte depolarization
rationale: All members regulate depolarization of working atrial and ventricular cardiomyocytes, distinct from neighbours on nodal/conduction-system action potentials and repolarization.

qualifier: attachment, entry, protein maturation and assembly
name: Viral attachment, entry, protein maturation and assembly
rationale: Members span viral entry, protein processing and virion assembly across coronaviruses, dengue, RSV, influenza and HIV, unlike neighbours focused on viral genome replication, transcription and translation.

qualifier: p21 G1 arrest and intrinsic apoptosis
name: p53 activation driving p21 G1 arrest and intrinsic apoptosis
rationale: Members cover TP53 expression and co-factor regulation leading to p21-mediated G1 arrest and DNA damage intrinsic apoptosis, unlike neighbours on p53 degradation, caspase transcription or p14ARF/p16 defects.

name: Non-oxidative pentose phosphate shunt and glycerol/fructose metabolism
rationale: Members cover non-oxidative PPP (TALDO1, RPIA, xylulose-5-P) with fructose, glycerol and alditol metabolism, distinct from glycolysis/glycogen and galactose/pentose catabolism neighbours.
